title: Add legacy schema adoption or reset path
description:
Handle databases created before the migration-first schema system.

Preferred behavior:
- If a DB already has the new schema_migrations ledger, use it.
- If a DB has the old meta.schema_version system, either:
  - migrate through the old TypeScript migration chain to the final legacy version, verify parity with the new baseline, then mark 0001_initial.sql as applied; or
  - fail closed with a clear pre-1.0 reset/recreate message if preserving old local DBs is not worth the complexity.
- If a DB is empty, apply all SQL migrations from zero.
- If a DB is neither empty nor recognized, fail closed.

Acceptance criteria:
- The chosen behavior is consistent with the migration policy document.
- Legacy behavior is covered by tests.
- Failure messages are actionable and do not silently modify unrecognized databases.
close_reason: Legacy adoption/reset path landed in PR #317 (merged). prepareDatabaseForMigrations + migrateDatabase + SchemaResetRequiredError, fingerprint-gated adoption at baseline 15, fail-closed otherwise.
